title: vanilla expanded
description: a data pack to improve your minecraft world
body:
Vanilla expanded is a data pack for Minecraft that adds new items and mechanics to your world


<details>
<summary>features</summary>
  
New items like the Healing staff and the wand
  
New recipes for items in the game

New magic mechanic using the wand with 2 spells currently, fireball and the poison vacuum

new infusions to make items stronger

spleef gamemode(/trigger spleef)
</details>
